prompt:
Scene:
A square cinematic matte-painting style illustration, medium shot at the base of the same silver finned rocket from the reference. Camera eye-level, just to the left of the gantry stair. Warm afternoon sun, long cinematic shadows, powder-blue sky matching the reference. Subtle film grain, gentle vintage travel-short color grading.

Subject:
At the bottom of the gantry, three stylized passengers in pastel flight suits (powder pink, turquoise, ivory) and clear fishbowl bubble helmets are boarding up the chrome steps toward an oval pressure hatch in the rocket flank. A chrome-trimmed hostess in a cadmium-red flight uniform stands on the pad holding a flight manifest clipboard, smiling and gesturing them upward. A single yellow-striped ground cart with soft round luggage sits to the side. The rocket body and its three red horizontal stripes from the reference are visible overhead.

Important details:
Rocket body proportions, red-stripe placement, and chrome color must match the reference exactly. The gantry spiral from the reference should be partially visible to tie the shot. Bubble helmets are transparent fishbowls. Uniforms are pastel flight-suit style. Crowd is a small group of stylized figures, not photoreal. Keep matte-painting illustration feel.

Use case:
Silver Rocket Terminal series shot 2 of 4, a boarding detail inside the same scene as the reference.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no modern spacesuits, no SpaceX branding, no photoreal faces, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, preserve the reference rocket.
